brief.workingTitle: A Prayer for Faith When You Feel Afraid
brief.format: Original spoken Christian devotional; vertical 9:16, licensed cinematic moving footage, legible mobile captions
brief.openingHook: When fear is louder than your faith, pray this with me.

scripture.shortQuote: Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.
scripture.accuracyNote: Use the father asking Jesus to help his unbelief as an illustration; do not imply faith ensures an immediate specific outcome.

brief.spokenScript: When fear is louder than your faith, pray this with me. In Mark 9:24, a father cried, ‘Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.’ Jesus, meet me where my faith feels weak. Teach me to trust You when I cannot see the answer. Give me courage for the next step, peace for tonight, and strength to keep praying. My hope is in You, not in perfect feelings. Amen.
brief.closingOnScreen: Mark 9:24 • Save this prayer for a difficult day
brief.caption: If your faith feels small today, you can still bring it to Jesus. “Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.” — Mark 9:24 (KJV). Save this prayer for the days trusting God feels hard.
brief.originality: Do not copy other creators' hooks, scripts, recordings or footage.
